headline: Incredible creamy & pigmented, yet super blendable!
comments: I received this as a gift frim a friend in the shade 3. Let me tell you, I am super fair skinned, freckled, red-headed so I was intimidated! I have used many a cream bronzer and product so I am very familiar with how to apply. I was shook that this worked for me and went on beautifully! It actually wasn't too dark, I went in very light handed with my brush and it blends out like a dream but gave me the most gorgeous sun kissed glow. Normally, I play it super safe and go with the lightest shade in every single bronzer but I think if you are fair, you absolutely can get away with the shade 2 or 3. That is a testament to how good this product is, it's not orange at all. The texture is unbelievable-so creamy that you just need a slight dab of your brush and you can build as needed. This will last me forever, so price wise, if I HAD to purchase it myself, it would be worth every penny. Plus, the packaging and mirror are lovely.

headline: Neopolitan cream review
comments: I had high hopes for this being the perfect all in one cream face palette. The formula is thick and very pigmented. It didn't blend well with fingers or a wet sponge. It was workable using a buffing brush and dried down quickly and completely. I have a fair cool skin tone and the matte and shimmery blushes both lean a bit orangey on me. The bronzer shade is pretty deep for fair skin but it has a rosy tone so I can make it work if I only apply a tiny bit. The highlighter is nice and subtle, not too bright. I used the bronzer and highlighter it as eyeshadow and that worked out ok. I tried some on my lips but it felt thick and dry and none of the colors really work well for that in my opinion. Overall I have mixed feelings about this product but am willing to play with a bit more. In general, I wish the formula was thinner and more sheer like their water blush and bronzer.

I use it almost every day when I wear makeup and I can't tell that I have even put a dent in it and I have had it for at least a month now. I know it is pricey, but the bronzer is huge, so I don't mind the price point, especially since you don't need to use a lot since the color payoff is so great. It is really hard for me to find a bronzer that actually works for me since I am so pale and I have dry skin. So I absolutely recommend the fair shade if you are pale like me!

headline: Lovely bronzer
comments: I used a brush to lightly apply and build up to the "tanned" look I wanted. This product is so natural and long-wearing.  I am glad I did not talk myself out of buying such an expensive bronzer because this is the best one I have ever used.

headline: Incredible creamy & pigmented, yet super blendable!
comments: I received this as a gift frim a friend in the shade 3. Let me tell you, I am super fair skinned, freckled, red-headed so I was intimidated! I have used many a cream bronzer and product so I am very familiar with how to apply. I was shook that this worked for me and went on beautifully! It actually wasn't too dark, I went in very light handed with my brush and it blends out like a dream but gave me the most gorgeous sun kissed glow. Normally, I play it super safe and go with the lightest shade in every single bronzer but I think if you are fair, you absolutely can get away with the shade 2 or 3. That is a testament to how good this product is, it's not orange at all. The texture is unbelievable-so creamy that you just need a slight dab of your brush and you can build as needed. This will last me forever, so price wise, if I HAD to purchase it myself, it would be worth every penny. Plus, the packaging and mirror are lovely.

headline: My one and only ride or die bronzer
comments: This is the only bronzer I've ever tried that looks totally natural, doesn't break me out, and doesn't turn me orange.  Ive tried many including Pat Mgrath, Too Faced, Guerlain, ABH, Bare Minerals, Tarte, Nars, and a few others and they all either show up orange, break me out, apply super patchy, or just look unnatural on my skin, (I have light-light medium skin with a neutral undertone that leans slightly cool).  Hourglass, though expensive, is my ride or die.  I swear by this stuff.  Ive used both shades Nude and Diffused and I prefer Nude because it looks completely natural and subtle and blends beautifully, and it makes my skin look so healthy, luminous, and perfectly sun kissed (Diffused was slightly too cool for me, almost more of a contour shade).  I cannot recommend this stuff enough.  And it lasts forever too!  The mini size lasted me nearly a year and i bought the larger one a month or two ago and have barely made a dent in it.  I also have oily skin and this stays on for over 12 hours and does not make my skin more greasy.  If you've had trouble finding a non comedogenic bronzer or every bronzer you've tried makes you look orange, or if you want something a bit more subtle but natural and beautiful I seriously recommend you try this!

headline: Diffused Bronze Light Review
comments: I am a Clear/Bright Winter in seasonal color analysis. I have light olive skin that tans well, but I avoid sun for health reasons. My face is always lighter than my body. It picks up color in summer, even with sunblock on. I want to match my face to my body. My color analyst told me not to use contouring or bronzing products because it will muddy my complexion. She said I can use highlighters. I told her I did not like having a light face, and I asked if I should wear darker foundation. She recommended Hourglass Diffused Light because it is not an obvious brown, but a rosy glow like exercising. When I compare my light face to my darker shoulders, it looks more even with this product on. I love it very much and I am glad I took her advice. I used to wear Chanel Soleil de Tan and others, but I do not miss them because they were flat brown. This one is so luminous without being glittery.

headline: Possibly the best cream bronzer ever!
comments: I kind of bought this product out of nowhere. I was shopping around in ulta and it was for sale- having liked almost every other Juvia's product that I've tried before; I decided to pick it up. First of all, I personally feel like you get A LOT of product for the price/size of the container. Secondly, this stuff is like- buttery smooth. It does not dry down quickly either, which in my opinion makes it easier to work with. It also layers well with foundation/blushes/powders. It does have a very slight shimmer to it, but as an avid user of CT Flawless Filter- I actually liked that. There was not really any scent that I could detect, and my very picky skin reacted well to it. I have since incorporated this into my every day routine and it is easily one of my new favorite products. Also, it's not too warm, not too cool- which as a neutral girly, I appreciate!

headline: Amazing Sculpting Product
comments:
Anytime I do a full face, this is the product I grab for my cream bronze/contour. 
I'm very fair with cool/neutral undertones and the lightest shade is perfect. Not too orange or yellow - looks very natural and flattering. It's almost like a hybrid between what my perfect bronzer and contour shade would be, so I use it as a one and done.
Product is super buttery smooth and easy to apply and blend. I usually take a clean brush (Real Techniques angled brush), circle it in the product, apply, blend, done. Super easy.
Only cons are it's a very shallow pan (haven't hit pan yet though) and I wish it was in more sanitary packaging. I usually prefer sticks for ease and sanitary but so far I haven't had any visible issues with the product. This has actually replaced some of my prestige brand products!

headline: Amazing!!
comments: I have been on a bronzer journey lately and have tried so so so so many. The majority of them are first, too orange, too yellow, or too red. I felt in the end, that maybe looking a little washed out was a better option and was even using a blush to give myself some more color and definition. I bought the Nabla highlighter/blush in this same line and adored them and when the bronzers went on sale I decided to give them a shot. Hands down, these are the best I have ever tried!!!! The most natural and flattering for sure. They arent patchy at all and just melt into the skin....it just looks like my skin, but with some color and definition added back in! I can actually get them to stick in my hairline and blend in and look like nothing but beautiful, glorious skin! I know I keep saying skin, but hello beautiful, naturally bronzed and glowing SKIN!! xD anyway, yes, finally found the last bronzer I will purchase. Oh, got these in the shades Dune and Soft Revenge. They both look gorgeous and I've been using both at the same time, Revenge more like a contour and blending with Dune. Some are saying there is no pigment, there totally is but you have to use a stiff brush for these baked formulas. They give you so much control, you just have to build, which is hugely important to me as the last thing I want is a super pigmented, patchy bronzer. These build and I think would be hard to make patchy, just so user friendly. Great place to start for a beginner bronzer user, cant mess these up I don't think.

headline: Soft Revenge changes the game as contour
comments:
This product is unique. I bought the shade Soft Revenge, which is more neutral. When I saw it, I suspected the color would make a great contour shade for my medium, golden-olive tone. I was right.

The texture of this is so smooth and natural, and the pigmentation is such that it imitates the look of shadow on your face, which is the idea of contour. Other bronzing/contouring powders can be too heavy in pigmentation or texture, or not the right shade. Other products will look blotchy, patchy, stripey, or unblendable. Not this product!

I apply this with the bdellium tools 945 contour brush. When I dip my brush in the pan, there is no kick up or dustiness and it's almost hard to tell that I've even picked up any product, but that gives me great control in building and blending the product!

To apply the product, I gently tap and make tiny circle motions in the hollows of my cheeks.

This product actually makes me want to contour more because it's so easy and low maintenance. It gives a natural-looking, soft, seamless, smooth effect.

headline: So good!  I'm sorry I doubted you, Pat!
comments: I love cream bronzers and normally I'm not interested in the powder ones. I saw two colors that I really liked and I bought Bronze Divinity and Burnished Honey as a blind buy. I have to be honest; the Wet n Wild Contouring Stick was a letdown. 🙁 The packaging feels cheap and flimsy, and the product broke after just a few uses, making it incredibly frustrating to use. And no, it didn't fall down, it broke in my makeup bag.

To make matters worse, the contouring color (medium brown) was just not flattering at all. It looked muddy and unnatural on my skin, leaving me looking like I had dirt smeared on my face. 

Overall, this product was a miss for me. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and attractive contouring stick.

headline: Neopolitan cream review

The bronzer shade is pretty deep for fair skin but it has a rosy tone so I can make it work if I only apply a tiny bit. The highlighter is nice and subtle, not too bright. I used the bronzer and highlighter it as eyeshadow and that worked out ok. I tried some on my lips but it felt thick and dry and none of the colors really work well for that in my opinion. Overall I have mixed feelings about this product but am willing to play with a bit more. In general, I wish the formula was thinner and more sheer like their water blush and bronzer.

The blushes and bronzer are all matte formulas, and then the highlighter is the Super Shock putty-cream like formula. Personally, I never liked the Super Shock formula because I prefer using brushes when doing my makeup, and none of my brushes can pick up this formula, leaving me to do it with my fingers. Okay, whatever. I can get over that. But the biggest problem that I have with this highlighter is that it is mostly GLITTER. I love a glitter highlighter now and then, but not when using an everyday palette for an everyday look. It looks so weird to have matte bronzer and blush, and then a stripe of glitter on my cheekbones. It would be fine if the highlighter was a cute shimmery color, like Lunch Money, but it's very glittery which sucks. Tbh, I bought a cheap Essence highlighter so that I could crush up the ColourPop one and transfer the Essence one into the compact so that I can actually have an all in one palette. Oh well.

It would be fine if the highlighter was a cute shimmery color, like Lunch Money, but it's very glittery which sucks. Tbh, I bought a cheap Essence highlighter so that I could crush up the ColourPop one and transfer the Essence one into the compact so that I can actually have an all in one palette. Oh well.

The first shade I ordered was Ember.  Usually deeper, richer colors work best with my medium-light olive skin, and on the monitor, this one appeared to be a red-brown.  What I received was actually coffee-colored with no red undertone, and the consistency was hard and waxy, even after sitting in my warm bathroom for several days.  I could never get my brush to pick up the color.  I'm saving this one for contouring in special effects makeup.  The next order, I picked up the shade Summer.  This one does look more like a suntan and my brush is able to pick it up, but the texture is still matte and almost pasty.  I'll probably keep it for use with my photography clients but it won't be the daily tinted moisture-balm product I was hoping for.

headline: My favorite pacifica product!!!
comments: I don't understand the mixed reviews of this on youtube. I never leave reviews and HAD to for this bronzer. I think it is the best product pacifica has ever made.  I apply it with a stippling brush and it just melts into the skin. The color Summer is gorgeous on my light neutral skintone. It is a warmer bronzer than my other bronzer i have (makeup my mario transforming skin perfector in light) and though the shade is different for me. I'm in love. And i think it is an almost spot on dupe for the jones road gel bronzer in medium that i've had my eye on. So glad i tried this instead. Please never discontinue. I know some reviews on youtube mentioned the product freling grainy. If you do feel it in your container just rub your finger over the product. ANY GRAINY FEELING IS FROM THE AIRY TEXTURE OF THE PRODUCT IT DOES NOT TRANSLATE TO BRUSHES DIPPED IN THE PRODUCT OR TO THE FACE. Do not let those reviews stop you from purchasing this gorgeous product. Pacifica make more shades if you'd like, but never discontinue or reformulate. Stunning and a pretty spot on dupe.

headline: this will last FOREVER
comments: I'm suuper pale but the Light Sand one looked like it was gonna be too pale for me so I opted to go for Summer. It is beautiful. It is a beautiful rich warm brown and it is not scary to use. I use a real techniques short bristle brush to dip in and put on my cheeks. It is perfect for cream bronzers like this one. This bronzer can pack a punch if you put too much on the brush but it does blend out nicely. I tend to put on the bronzer first and then put on my blush. If I put on my blush first, the bronzer can be a bit patchy because my blushes are also cream/balmy so the bronzer doesn't stick to areas there is already cream/balm blush. It will be PERFECT for the summertime and for when I have a bit of a tan going on later in summer/fall. I would buy this again, but it will definitely be a long time before that happens due to how much is in the container (it's insane how much product you get!! love it!!). It is fun for me to apply and for me, it has good staying power. I personally don't expect cream products to stay all day but this one is really nice and still adds warm to my face by the end of the day. It does fade slightly but it's still there.

headline: Excellent Buildable, Creamy Formulation
comments:
The formulation of this product is excellent for my dehydrated/dry skin type.  It blends in smoothly and the coverage is super light but buildable.  The texture and application is similar to the Pacifica Fluffy Blushy (I LOVE!!).  My slightly sensitive skin does not react so this product should be fine for people with mild Rosacea.  I have been applying it on the side of my nose, under my cheekbones, on my temples, and under my "double" chin.  

The one issue for me - and it's a big one - is color.  I'm mixed race so I have yellow and pink undertones and I wear neutral foundation.  This color is much too yellow/red for my complexion.  I cannot wear self-tanner (even high-end) due to this issue - it never looks natural on me.  I also cannot use most bronzers.  HOWEVER,  for those of you that can tan or look good with self-tanners this is a nice option.

Pacifica - if there is anyway you could add another bronzer color that is a more cool grayish brown (like Kevyn Aucoin Sculpting Powder) - Us neutral complected would be GRATEFULL!!!

Rock-on Pacifica!

+ Excellent Quality
+ Lots of Product - Large pot - will last a long while.

headline: Why is no one talking about this bronzer??

This bronzer is beautiful with a light touch to add wear time to a cream bronzer, and when worn alone is *chef's kiss*. 
I chose the shade "Vacay" and its the PERFECT rosy tone without looking too much like a blush. For reference, I have always loved the color of the original tarte "Park Avenue Princess" but don't always want a shimmery bronzer PLUS I don't love the tarte formula. I've been trying to find a bronzer thats the same tone/color as PA Princess in a powder formula that i actually enjoy using. Mented has nailed it with this color AND formula! Other cosmetic brands could also take note on the thin, luxe-feeling component that is almost as lovely as the product inside.

If you're cool toned and struggle with bronzer being too warm, try VACAY! Hopefully, Mented will broaden the shade range so that more skin tones can love this product as much as I do!

headline: Why is no one talking about this bronzer??
comments:
This is the most beautiful bronzer that I have ever used. Period.
It's a finely milled powder that although quite pigmented, is never streaky and is easy to blend. I'm a dry/very dry skinned girlie who has to be careful with powder products and how they play with my skin prep. This bronzer is beautiful with a light touch to add wear time to a cream bronzer, and when worn alone is *chef's kiss*. 
I chose the shade "Vacay" and its the PERFECT rosy tone without looking too much like a blush. For reference, I have always loved the color of the original tarte "Park Avenue Princess" but don't always want a shimmery bronzer PLUS I don't love the tarte formula. I've been trying to find a bronzer thats the same tone/color as PA Princess in a powder formula that i actually enjoy using. Mented has nailed it with this color AND formula! Other cosmetic brands could also take note on the thin, luxe-feeling component that is almost as lovely as the product inside.

If you're cool toned and struggle with bronzer being too warm, try VACAY! Hopefully, Mented will broaden the shade range so that more skin tones can love this product as much as I do!

In the tube, it looks like a warm champagne pinkâa shade I assumed would be too dark and warm for my CN 0.5 Shell (very pale and pink) skin tone. headline: Great Glow And NO Sparkle!

I have mature skin, but a very nice complexion, thanks to Clinique & my skin care routine. However, most highlighters are too glittery for my taste & my age. Most of these are powder highlighters.
The Chubby Stick is creamy & understated. You don't get an overdose with just one swipe. You can put enough on to play around with & get the look you want. Just a nice natural glow that doesn't look like glittery makeup.
My new routine is a 50 sunscreen, dabs of concealer where I need it instead of full face foundation, Chubby Glow Stick on apples, light application of finishing powder. Looks great.

It's essential to store it very carefully and avoid any pressure on the palette to prevent damage.

headline: Staple in my collection

comments: As I'm getting older my dark circles are getting worse. I tried the yellow color correcter to combat my dark circles which it does brighten the area. I've tried other dark circle brighteners/color corrections from more expensive brands & this one works the best but a little goes a long way. If I try to use it straight out of the tube it ends up looking like I'm recovering from two black eyes, like they've turned the light yellow right before bruises are gone. I think the pink one would work better instead because I have cool undertones but all the color correcting products I've tried have been yellow which is why I went with the yellow in this. However, if I put this on my finger to warm it up some & make it creamy I can put small dots of it under my eyes. I have to be carefully blend it out & cover it well with my other concealer but it does brighten them much more than concealer alone. If I don't cover enough it does look weirdly bright yellow. That's my fault for using the wrong color for my skin though. For those that say it's too dry I think if you do what I do & put it on your hand first to warm it up it goes on much more creamy. I probably end up wasting product though doing it this way but it works better. I'm going to get the pink & see if that matches my skin tone better so that's the only thing I'd be aware of & why I didn't give it 5 stars. I have a wonderful pot concealer from NYX but I have to use a brush with it. I was looking for something with the same type coverage but easier to put on. Since these can go from medium to full coverage & the colors that aren't corrective would work well too I'll probably get one of those even though I love the one I have in the pot.

headline: Amazing
comments:
Urban Decay's Long Lasting Makeup Setting Spray with Hyaluronic Acid and Watermelon Fruit Extract is an impressive addition to any makeup routine. This setting spray stands out with its unique blend of ingredients, ensuring both longevity and hydration. The inclusion of hyaluronic acid provides a significant boost of moisture, keeping the skin plump and fresh throughout the day. Meanwhile, the watermelon fruit extract adds a refreshing touch, giving a subtle, pleasant fragrance without being overpowering.

The performance of this setting spray is notable. It effectively locks in makeup for hours, preventing smudging and fading even in humid conditions. The spray's fine mist ensures even coverage, setting makeup without leaving a sticky or heavy residue. Additionally, it's suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, thanks to its gentle, hydrating formula.

Overall, Urban Decay's setting spray with hyaluronic acid and watermelon fruit extract is a standout product, combining excellent makeup-setting capabilities with skin-friendly ingredients. Whether for a long day at work or a night out, this setting spray is a reliable choice for keeping your makeup looking flawless.

headline: Works great. Smells great.
comments:
Urban Decay's All Nighter Makeup Spray is such a classic. I have gone thru so many bottles over the years. The Hyaluronic Acid Watermelon Fruit Extract version is an elevated version of the original. 

I generally avoid "dewy" products since my natural glisten is out of control. This spray gives more of a refreshed look. It comes out in fine mist and goes on completely clear. It's not drying but also doesn't look like I just sprayed myself down. It's like fresh moisturized skin in a bottle.

As far as function is concerned, I do feel like my makeup lasted better. While skin prep is the most important for make-up longevity, the setting spray decreased transferring and creasing. 

The best part is the scent...a sweet watermelon candy. I would buy perfume that smells like this spray in a heartbeat. 

Overall, I think I prefer this over OG. The pink bottle, watermelon scent, and natural finish are phenomenal.

headline: Pricey but great
comments: I am a man with extremely red skin not caused by rosacea. I also use this product after applying shaving cream to lock in my aftershave balm! I have super dry skin but this does not further dry it out. I do wish NYX would add variations with SPF and color correction (green) but I will keep buying this otherwise! I do think it's a bit expensive but I won't go without it. The spray is great, too. Very light but uniform. I know most women will have different goals than mine, but I highly recommend this setting spray. It will keep your face intact all day and night!

headline: Great quality, not the best for very pale skin
comments: I'm giving this 5* because the quality really is lovely, and I appreciate the fact that they give you so much more of the contour colors, given that those are the ones that tend to get used up quickest (at least for me). That said, this will be getting returned because as someone who is very, very pale, it's just not a good fit. The lightest contour shade is PERFECT for me. I'll likely buy a single of that. But the light color on the top left is still just a bit too dark to set my undereyes and is too dark for a highlight. The peach shade is odd for me, too, as it's far too peach to work as anything other than eyeshadow. I can use the middle contour as a bronzer if I use a light hand, but the darkest contour is far too pigmented on me and is relegated to eyeshadow. So all in all, there's one shade that truly works for my pale skin in terms of contour & highlighting, and the others are basically eyeshadow. I'd say if you're light to tan skin tone, this is probably a fantastic option for you but if you're darker complected or very fair, it may not offer you enough range.

headline: Unexpected holy grail product.
comments:
I was sent this product for free by the company via BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review. I was ready to be disappointed since I did not get to choose the shade, which wouldn't have mattered since typically tints and foundations makes my skin look either orange or like some weird Victorian porcelain. I had basically completely given up on all tinted product, but the Pink Pearl shade of the Complexion Rescue All-Over Luminizer SPF20 is the first tinted anything that MATCHES MY SKIN. 

You do not need to be careful applying this and can apply as liberally as you would like, it doesn't have the caking factor some other products have. There is also no white cast at all.  And it could be all in my head but this product is a pill STOPPER. I am a person that uses whatever product strikes my fancy in the moment, so pilling is a fact of life; but when I smear this on, I swear it will melt pills that have already formed as it lightly hides imperfections and redness while also bringing out my natural tone. There is mica based glitter in this, but it is not overwhelmingly sparkly. And though I am sensitive to something related to mica in products, it has not caused me a single issue in a month of continuous use.

It is only 20 SPF but that SPF does work amazingly well. The sun HATES me, being in the sun can be physically painful, like sunbeams stomping on my face in radiation shoes - but when I am wearing the bareminerals complexion rescue I can actually enjoy time in the sun without wanting to puke. IDK which ingredient causes this, since I have used all the ingredients in other products before without such a drastic effect, but it has really improved my quality of life. I would definitely recommend layering this with another SPF, even though it reduces the sun's effectivity, it does not fully stop it, I did see some sun related changes to my skin when only using this product as protection.

headline: Staple in my collection
comments: I'm pretty fair and most foundations that match my depth pull too pink on me, especially drug store ones. I use the green corrector to adjust the shade of too-pink foundations to better match me. It works like a charm! Just a small dab mixed in makes all the difference in the undertone. I find it a bit too dry on my already dry skin to use on it's own, but I use so little of it as a mixing agent that I don't find it alters the finish of my foundations. It look me at least a year to make it through one tube of this using it this way. Way cheaper to adjust pink drug store foundations than splurge on high end/luxury brands where I still can't find a 100% perfect shade match. I'll never be without this stuff!

headline: The peach corrector covers my dark spots
comments: This is a quality product that works! The peach corrector covers my dark spots and works well with my other makeup. Just a dab is needed. While it's not a deal breaker, I dislike the applicator, but it was easy to remove.

headline: LIGHT YELLOW corrector is AMAZING on fair skin
comments: I have fair skin without acne but occasional general pinkness around the t zone due to irritation. This corrector blends easily with fingers and completely neutralizes my skin tone as if i have foundation on. It doesn't cling to dry patches and maintains even pigment. It has a natural finish but doesn't slide around my face even without powder. It sticks to my nose evenly and doesn't settle in pores. I can throw it on it looks undetectable up close to anyone but me. I was just shocked by how well this performed with little effort. This is like a high end complexion product and served the exact purpose I was hoping. Im excited to try the peach corrector for under eyes and perhaps the concealers out of curiosity (but i dont even need it with this corrector!)

headline: Best make purchase I HAVE EVER MADE.
comments: I didn't realize how much my dark circles were bothering me until I used this product and this hue stick corrected in a way no other product has. Amazing. I'm brown skinned- the Perk color worked flawlessly. I feel like a million bucks.

headline: Amazing. Miracle worker
comments: I have never written a review for anything, but I just had to write one for this product for girls/women struggling with hyperpigmentation that shows even through makeup. This absolutely is a game changer, especially the shade rise. I have medium deep brown Indian skin. I have a lot of hyperpigmentation around my mouth, chin, under eyes, and deep acne scars. I have tried everything to cover it up. The closest I got to making it work was the LA GIRL orange corrector, but it was too orange. I wanted a more natural orange. It was also horrible to try to blend, like toothpaste especially on dry skin. This was an absolute game changer. I tried it on a whim, not expecting any miracles from it. I'm so happy I did because this covered all my hyperpigmentation without any foundation or concealer. I put this on and put the smallest amount of concealer and it looks flawless. Please do not discontinue. Absolutely love it.

headline: Perk and aurora-olive skin fair/light
comments: I bought both correcters. Perk is for my dark hispanic mustache shadow, and aurora is for the green around my eyes. They work pretty darn good. I am 36 and do not have issues with it being overly drying since I moisturize pretty good at night. My friend has severe hyperpigmentation (medium skin) and talked her into getting the brick red to cancel out the darkness and it worked like magic! This hue stick and benefits cakeless concealer work flawlessly together.

headline: Love this product!
comments: I went in looking for a different brand and when I shared what type of product I was looking for, the store rep pointed me to this and chose my color for me. I couldn't be happier- so easy to apply and does the job that my concealer alone cannot. I FINALLY have a handle on covering my dark circles. I highly recommend!

headline: Perfect color but too dry for under eye
comments:
The color of this was spot on for my brown skin with neutral undertone. For reference perfect match foundations for me are, Pat McGrath in MD26, Tom Ford Chestnut, MAC NC50, Tarte 53N. 
The delivery of the stick make it very easy for under eyes and sides of nostrils, and you don't need much. It also blends well and stays put under concealer and foundation. It is truly a great color corrector, and very close to being a favorite. Unfortunately, the texture is too dry for my under eye area and wasn't the best look regardless of what type of concealer I used with it. My skin is balanced but, like most people, my under eye area is a bit dry. I understand cream textures may crease more, so this balm-like stick seemed perfect at first. But unfortunately, it just doesn't wear well in that area. For other parts that need correcting, this is perfect.

headline: Best under eye product
comments:
Worls like magic. Hides dark circles and does bot crease. Blends easy. Most color correcting does not look goos solo and this one sure does- looks good under makeup and by its self ubder eyes. 
I have tried many and highly recommend this. 
I am 42, mature skin. So happy! Thank tou Flower Beauty for an amazing product.

headline: Not Great

headline: Great product
comments: This product is everything I was looking for and more! I love to use this on my bare skin for no-makeup days, and it blends so seamlessly with my skin tone. I got the second lightest shade, and it is great because it does not have a specific skin tone pigment, as it is a corrector, so this will work with varying skin tones as long as you choose your correct shade range. I love placing this under my eyes to even out discoloration, set with powder, and I am good for the day. Highly recommend to give this product a try, it is now my new staple! And it is so beneficial that it just so happens to have great skincare ingredients as well. I'm in love!!!

headline: Get it.
comments:
I pretty much gave up on covering my dark circles until I bought this product. Every under eye concealer I've bought in the past has creased under my eyes, looked cakey or felt too heavy. 

This concealer is smooth and blends easily. I love how it feels on my skin. In the photos I applied product on the right only to show the difference. I used the under eye concealer pencil and the dream warrior mascara. This is after one layer with the pencil + gentle padding to blend it in and two light layers of mascara. 

This product is awesome! Hats off to the team 👏🏼 

Price point is excellent and great for people like me who don't like to wear a lot of makeup and therefore don't like to spend a ton of money.

headline: Shockingly Good!!
comments: Undereye Concealer is my deserted island product thanks to 50+ yrs old dryness + hollowing AND genetic DARK (purple) circles. Have everything from Cle De Peau, currently loving Iris&Romeo w/Armani Luminous, but it's 4 step process for near perfect results. This rivals them! Is it full coverage, seamless perfection? No - but close. This is my 'weekend / no-makep' concealer. Couple of swipes w/ delicate knead/pat. Not my usual 4 step process but this applies easy, covers well, lovely finish, in like 40 secs. Perfect to tote in purse for quick touch ups right before happy hour. For what it specifically is, it's unparalleled product!

headline: I don't even need foundation!
comments: I am so happy to have stumbled across this product from one of my favorite brands. I have always had pikachu cheeks & very fair sensitive skin which is prone to sunburns. I still struggle to find foundations to match my skintone & cover the redness. I am happy to report I needn't look further!!!! The green pigments blend out very easily w/ the warmth of my fingers. I find it best to "mix" on the back of my hand before rubbing into my skin. But I doubt that step would even make a significant difference as it'll blend either way. Ulta never stop carrying this please! Even if it's limited to online only 🫶🏻

headline: Horrible for DRY SKIN and silicone based eye cream
comments: I really, really wanted to love this product! It looks great on the models in the videos, and I wanted that glowy look for my super dry skin. The color I purchased was a perfect match.    However, it looks terrible on me! It doesn't "stick" to most of my skin, just settles into every line. Adding setting powder made me look 20 years older.    I had multiple chats with NARS Artists, trying to troubleshoot my issues.    We finally determined that my eye cream contains silicone based ingredients, which causes this water based formula to split. There should be a WARNING on the product that says it can't be used with skin care products that contain silicone.    I would love to see this product in a formula that works with silicone based products, as I would definitely give it another try.

The only con for me is the price, but that said I do think it's worth it (especially as a gift). The blush is also neutral enough that it's a great one-stop everyday palette if you only like having a few staple makeup items.

However, my last purchase of this product has me questioning everything. Not only does it not seem to have the same staying power as before, but the finish is horribly chalky! It adds so much unflattering texture and pallor to my skin. This setting powder has always been a "safe" translucent powder in my opinion when it comes to looking chalky or washed out, or not getting "hey sister'd" when you take a picture with flash, but something has changed and the white sheen of the powder is more obvious than it ever has been. I ended up not finishing my container and purchasing another finishing powder from another brand. Such a disappointment. :(

headline: Effective setting powder for dry and normal skin
comments: I received Ultra Blur Rose Translucent Loose Setting Powder from BzzAgent and Laura Mercier, to try the product and provide my honest opinion.  The product definitely smooths out my pores and gives a flawless finish initially.  I appreciated the light texture of this product. I have been getting several hours of wear from the powder, but nowhere near the 16 hours promised.  My skin is fairly oily, and I think this product may be better-suited for dry or normal skin, since it is talc-free and includes hyaluronic acid for hydration.  The peachy pink tint is barely discernible, but it definitely gives fairer skin a pickup glow.  The product recommends applying with a powder puff, but no powder puff is included.  At this price point, this was surprising.  Overall, a good product with a light finish, but it does not keep oily skin shine-free for long.

headline: Works Great and Love the Price
comments:
I discovered this setting spray when my makeup artist used it on me for my wedding day! My makeup of course stayed wonderfully that day. I try other setting sprays here and there but I tend to come back to this one. 
For example, I like the Benefit Professional Setting Spray because it has a finer misting feel and makes me look a little more smooth/poreless BUT I get a lot more transfer with that setting spray and it's just expensive. I find this Makeup Revolution spray to keep my makeup from budging better and barely any transfer when I blot with a tissue. My forehead actually stays pretty matte too which is shocking, the only shininess I still get is my nose but that's okay with me cuz my nose is just freaking oily lol. So touching up my powder during the day on my nose fixes that. But overall this spray holds my makeup amazingly for having oily skin. I do agree with others saying that the finish isn't really matte though. So what I do is apply my Rimmel Stay Matte primer, then Maybelline Fit Me powder, and then spray this spray and let dry. Then apply my foundation and spray a bit of the spray on my sponge to mix with the foundation as I apply it. Then set everything with powder and do the rest of my routine. headline: This stuff is amazing!

They recommended using color correctors so that you can use less concealer, and thus reduce the amount of creasing and settling into fine lines (and also use less powder). This was one of the recommended ones (I bought a few of the recommended products). I used it over the weekend on the first day, by itself. I couldn't believe how little I needed, and HOW WELL IT WORKED just on its own. My daughter looked at me and said, "you look differentâ¦.. like younger".  First win! I then wore it over the course of 4 working days under 3 different concealers (LancÃ´me Teint Idole, Dermablend Full Coverage Concealer, and Fenty We're Even Hydrating concealer). All three required SIGNIFICANTLY less concealer than I would have applied without the corrector, and they all looked beautiful. They lasted all day, with LancÃ´me lasting all day with no creasing (the other two creased just a tiny bit, not really noticeable unless you're right up to my eyes). My eyes didn't look as dry or old as with normal amounts of concealer. This stuff is phenomenal. I did buy the Elf corrector to compareâ¦.. I did not find Elf to work as well by itself, and it had more of a greasy texture that didn't make me feel like it would last the way Charlotte Tilbury would. This is DEFINITELY worth every penny. If you're on the fence, do it.

Clinique's Even Better All-Over Primer and Color Corrector in Peach is a game-changer for anyone struggling with dark circles or spots. This lightweight color corrector is a true ally in my beauty arsenal, offering 12-hour wear that seamlessly integrates into my daily routine. 

The peach hue is perfect for my fair complexion, providing just the right amount of coverage without being overwhelming. It's not just a cover-up; it's a corrective experience that enhances my skin's natural beauty. The Vitamin C and niacinamide in the formula work wonders, visibly brightening my skin tone and giving me that much-coveted awake and refreshed look. What I love most is the creamy consistency that lays beautifully on the skin, coupled with the hyaluronic acid that hydrates and plumps up fine lines. The added caffeine reduces puffiness, making my eyes look more energized than ever. It's like a cup of coffee for my skin!

The sponge applicator is a thoughtful touch, making application a breeze and ensuring I can take this little tube of magic everywhere I go. Whether I'm heading to work or out for a night on the town, I know I can count on Clinique's Peach Color Corrector to keep me looking my best.

headline: Instant difference!

headline: You have to know how to use it.
comments:
With some testing I finally found the best way to use this:
1) dust on your chest, shoulders and upper arms to give you a little glow in the summer. 
2) mix 1/4 of this with a different loose setting powder and dust on with a big brush. 
3) This way gives me the most compliments- I put it on under my foundation and it gives a nice glowing look without looking glittery or sweaty. 

It can't be used as a setting powder by itself, but does have a lot of good uses.

I put it on and I immediately thought I was using it wrong like maybe it's a highlighter but no it is a setting powder. Also I tried to give it a fair shot, I used it with different shades of foundation, different ranges (being high end or drug store), and to even see I thought well maybe it would look good on bare skin to look glowy with slight coverage and even though I didn't look straight up silver it was still a huge negative. I wish I would've looked up more reviews on YouTube before I bought it but at least Ulta has a good return policy. Needless to say a huge mistake on this one!

headline: You have to know how to use it.
comments:
With some testing I finally found the best way to use this:
1) dust on your chest, shoulders and upper arms to give you a little glow in the summer. 
2) mix 1/4 of this with a different loose setting powder and dust on with a big brush. 
3) This way gives me the most compliments- I put it on under my foundation and it gives a nice glowing look without looking glittery or sweaty. 

It can't be used as a setting powder by itself, but does have a lot of good uses.

headline: I would not buy this product again
comments: Would not purchase this product again, definitely not a setting powder. Seems to be more of a highlight, Cosmic Rose was so pigmented. You cant blend it in at all, had to wash off all of my makeup and start from scratch.

headline: Love it but can't use it very often
comments: This formula contains those untraceable and extremely high quality mica sparkles that fancy sophisticated ladies tend to use on a night out. For a day look, I'll press the tiniest amount on my cheek bones, and then hit the tip of my nose and eyelids - it does have potential to be a glorious, shimmery eyeshadow. Like everybody else is mentioning in the comments, it's more of a highlighter than a setting powder, and if you're after a setting powder, spare yourself the pain and get the matte talc or talc free version. As a highlight/eye glimmer, this will last me 10 years.

headline: AMAZED by the oil control
comments:
For realâ¦. I FINALLY found a powder  that hides my oily skin ALL day.  

I have tried so many foundations, powders, primers and setting sprays to keep my face from looking greasy.   I have NEVER had a powder control my oil like this product.   My face didn't even feel greasy after a few hours like it always has my entire life.

The container is a little weird.  I feel like the " puff sponge " isn't the best for applying. I prefer my brush but I seem to spill the powder easily. Thats the only negative thing I can say.  

I was surprised this product didn't have better reviews. I am 50 years old and finally have found the perfect powder that keeps my face looking matte.  

No more "shine " for me!!'

headline: Not for me
comments: I got this as a gift to try. The powder made my brown skin look matte, but a but chalky. The applicator is cute and seemingly efficient, but not practical. You can't use it alone, you must blend with an additional brush or else you use too much powder.

headline: This is great
comments: I love this , Easy, quick, and when in a pinch throw it in your purse.. the powder takes oil away instantly. I have no idea why it has such a low rating,.. use a brush if the puff isn't hygienic enough .. it's a good price too

headline: New fave
comments: I absolutely love this convenient powder. It has the puff applicator in the lid, which is shaped like a handle. It couldn't be more perfect to use. It's easy to grab, no other tools needed, and go. The finish is high quality - finely milled. Not chalky or drying. Does a great job setting and absorbing oil. Lasts long time. New hg.

headline: Nope
comments: I should have paid better attention to the reviews. I attempted to use this product shortly after I received it and ended up with a powdery mess everywhere. The attached puff causes you to waste a ton of product and, at least for me, the powder did not blend well. Will end up tossing it unfortunately.

headline: SPF
comments:
This product is advertised on multiple sites (not just Ulta) for being SPF30.
But the packaging does not advertise anywhere about sun protection and neither does the physicians formula website.
However, the powder lists two sunscreens in its ingredients- zinc oxide (second ingredient) and titanium dioxide (last ingredient). 
It is suspicious. 
I end up using a face suncreen face spray then use this powder on top.
+Good for oily skin
-Needs more shades
-Terrible brush

headline: Not actually SPF 30?
comments: I use the other Physician's Formula mineral powder that features an SPF of 16, so I was excited to try this product because the Ulta app said it is SPF 30. Now that I have picked up my purchase neither the paper packaging nor the plastic packaging of the product says anything about SPF 30. It does contain zinc oxide, but it is one of the last ingredients and is not described as an active ingredient. The Ulta app shows the product as containing SPF 30, but the product itself does not. Also the translucent shade is cery much pigmented.

headline: Depends on your preference

headline: NOT SPF !!!
comments: This is NOT an spf powder. I do not know why it has that as the description here, there is no "active ingredients" list on the packaging, it does not say SPF anywhere on the packaging at all. This is just a powder it is not sunscreen at all!

headline: Don't know what I'd do without this product
comments:
I have very sensitive, oily, breakout-prone skin and on top of that I am extremely pale with yellow undertones. I have used so many different kinds of mineral makeup and they either break me out, make me look greasy within an hour, accentuate the texture of my skin, make my pores look huge, or the lightest shade is still too dark, too pink, or too orange.

The translucent shade matches me perfectly. No more orange or pink face with my white/yellow neck. Besides the relieving color match this stuff makes my skin look airbrushed. It is the only powder that has successfully blurred the large pores on my nose. The coverage is phenomenal and I use this alone as my foundation. I was worried about the lauroyl lysine breaking me out but no breakouts, no irritation, no itching. Also for some people saying this doesn't work well for them try to make sure your skin is properly primed. I first used this on bare skin and hated how it looked and almost tossed it but after that I made sure I was moisturized and wore a primer and the result was a complete 180.

headline: Terrific
comments: Absolutely LOVE this setting spray.  As a woman with mature skin I am careful wiht setting sprays.  I don't like them to be drying for obvious reasons.  But I don't want to look like a basted turkey, either.  This spray is wonderful.  First, it is a real mist.  No jet streams, no spitting, no droplets dotting my face and ruining my makeup.  Secondly, it gives me a lovely glow - that's GLOW, mind you.  Not oily.  I don't know why so many people think the two are interchangeable.  They're not.  Dewy/glowy are NOT the same as having a thick layer of grease on your face - And at the price you can't beat it.  I keep the bottle because the top can be screwed off.  Smashbox's Photo Finish Revitalize 8-in-1 Primer Essence also has a great mist with a screw off top.  What I do is once the product is used up, I wash the bottle and decant the product from any other setting spray that squirts instead of spraying.  Of course the other setting spray must also come in a bottle that you can easily screw the top off.  But if it doesn't I still take the time to spray the stuff into my Pacifica - or Smashbox -  bottle if the faulty bottle is not too big.  Yes, it's like milking cows, but it's better than throwing a product away, especially if it is costly.  That, or I just crack the bottle open and decant the stuff.  Saves money and a lot of aggravation.  Make sure you always shake the product before you change bottles, though.  Hope this helps.

headline: Great To Blend, Not to Set
comments:
A lot of reviews said this wasnt for sensitive skin and that made me really nervous as someone with SUPER sensitive skin + eczema. 

However, I am REALLY surprised with how well I like it! I havent had any issues with break outs or irritation and my skin looks AMAZING! It makes me glow and look so dewy and smooth! Its great for blending my water-based products and makes me smell SO good! 

One con is that it doesn't really set the makeup. My guess is that it's because it's so dewy. I work in a high-volume tourist area so I wear masks for a minimum of 8hrs/day and by the end of my work day, my makeup is smudged or clean off where my mask has touched. Even days when I don't wear a mask, like at home, my makeup budges with little resistance.

For reference, my go-to drug store setting spray is usually milani, which is usually a little too drying/alcohol smelling for me but keeps it held ALL day. I wish this one was a little stronger but I definitely love it otherwise.

Pros:
Talc-free formula, which is ideal for those with sensitive skin
SPF 25 for sun protection
Ultra-fine powder that blends easily and gives a weightless feel
Absorbs oil to control shine and keep makeup in place
Blurs the appearance of pores and fine lines
Vegan and cruelty-free

Cons:
Loose powder can be messy to apply
May not be enough coverage for those who want to conceal blemishes
SPF 25 is not very high protection
Built-In brush is a bit small 

Overall, the Bare Minerals Original Mineral Veil Set + Protect Talc-Free Setting Powder Mineral SPF 25 is a good option for those looking for a lightweight setting powder that will control shine and blur imperfections. I would use this for travel and on-the-go touch-ups, as it's a perfect size for in my purse or carryon.

comments:

headline: Almost returned, but so glad I didn't!
comments: I'm in my mid-30s and have been a long-time user of Laura Mercier loose powder. I completely ran out of powder recently and my local Ulta didn't have the Laura Mercier powder in stock in my shade. An employee recommended this Charlotte Tilbury pressed powder, said it was very blurring and didn't settle into fine wrinkles. I matched my shade, came home. I wore it for two days, and I kept catching glimpses of myself in the mirror at work, noticing exaggerated fine lines under my eyes and a cake-y texture. Did not care for that. The third time I wore it was the day I was planning to return it. I applied it a lot less heavy under my eyes that day, and while clothes shopping with my daughter kept noticing how smooth my complexion and pores looked in the dressing room mirror. I decided to keep using it a little longer, and realized that initially I was applying it heavy under my eyes like I did with the Laura Mercier powder. Once I backed off a little, everything balanced out. A dab will definitely do with this product. I'm still acclimating, but I think I really like it!

headline: Best Pressed Powder

Most powders look very cakey and dry on my skin, especially under my eyes, but this applies very smoothly and stays all day (cry and sweat proof if you use a good primer/setting spray duo). I know some have complained about this product oxidizing and looking orange on them. Personally, I have not had any issues with that. I use the lightest shade and have olive undertones (for reference, I wear the F2 Olive shade in the About Face foundation in the winter and the L2 Olive shade when I have a bit of a tan), and this blends seamlessy. If you have very fair skin, I recommend swatching first to make sure it doesn't oxidize and works well with your skin tone.

headline: Finally something that lasts!
comments: After using the Maybelline Fit Me! powder for several years, I've been on the hunt for a pressed powder that lasts longer through the day, but is on-the-go friendly in case I do need a touch-up. It also did not separate, make my makeup look cakey, and looked smooth and natural all day long. This compact does not come with a sponge/powder puff, but if you have your own that is thin, it will fit inside on top of the powder. The packaging itself is nice and slim which is great if you carry a smaller bag or want to pop it in your pocket. An Ulta employee suggested this powder to me and I am so glad she had me try it or else I may not have given it a chance!

headline: Doesn't Do Much
comments: I was so excited to try out this setting spray! I didn't buy it for years because of the price. Now that my bottle is about half gone, I have to say that I'm pretty disappointed. I apply it liberally over setting powder - the same way I use all my other setting sprays - and my foundation rubs off throughout the day. I was just trying to remove a spot of mascara from my cheek and my foundation rubbed off with it. Mind you, this is foundation that I've used many times before and never have an issue with. I typically use the Elf setting spray in the blue bottle and my makeup doesn't budge, even if I rub my face. I've only had makeup on for a few hours and it's like I didn't apply any setting spray at all. Other sprays also have a finer mist - this one does not, to my surprise.

headline: Turns eyeshadow into liner
comments: In the past I've used water in combination with eyeshadow to make a paste that I use as eyeliner. Some eyeshadows do not mix well with water so this spray is a huge improvement. I spray my brush, pick up the eyeshadow and it glides on effortlessly. The result is highly pigmented and it has staying power.

headline: Rosacea Miracle
comments: My husbands Aunt bought this powder for me back in May.  I was sharing my Rosacea woes with her.  The next day she brought me this pressed powder.  Game changer! I wear minimal make up.  I wash twice daily, apply cream, sun screen and then the Clinique Redness Solutions Powder.  I work in the medical field so am often masked up when seeing patients - my skin hates it! But with this powder I apply in the morning and re apply mid day.  The powder reduces my redness and break outs quite significantly.  Lasts forever.  I am right now replacing it 6 months later. Thank you Clinique!

headline: Will be returning this
comments: I bought this when out of town. I did not realize that Clinique had changed their Super Primer Color Corrects Redness from the powder cream to just powder. This new powder does Not cover the redness like the old formula nor does it leave your face feeling smooth. This can cake and flake and it does Not include any type of applicator. I will never buy it again. Clinique you ruined a loved product.

headline: Rosacea and Combo skin
comments:
This stuff is a game changer on top of my foundation right before my setting powder. I use the F.A.RA.H Pressed Powder brush with it and gently swirl it on my flair areas and it easily covers it up without looking cakey. 

At first I was applying it under my foundation and it wasn't working then ended up trying to add it over my foundation instead and that's what really worked for me.

headline: Life saver!
comments: I almost didn't purchase this because I was afraid I would look yellow but so glad I did! I have been experiencing red hot flare ups on my cheeks, nose, chin, and sometimes neck and chest for years. So much so that I've started waking up with red cheeks from broken capillaries. I use my regular foundation and put this on top and it leaves me with a nice even complexion. It just happens to be that my under eyes have more of a purple color so it even has helped cover those dark circles without looking dry and cakey.  I've also been using the redness solutions cream in the morning which has reduced the amount of red/hot episodes but when I do have them I just add a bit more of this powder over it and it instantly evens out my skin tone. I do wish it came with a sponge or applicator in the compact but it's still worth it. Love love love it!!

headline: A Touch of Radiance with Clinique's Peach Color Corrector
comments:
Clinique's Even Better All-Over Primer and Color Corrector in Peach is a game-changer for anyone struggling with dark circles or spots. This lightweight color corrector is a true ally in my beauty arsenal, offering 12-hour wear that seamlessly integrates into my daily routine. 

The peach hue is perfect for my fair complexion, providing just the right amount of coverage without being overwhelming. It's not just a cover-up; it's a corrective experience that enhances my skin's natural beauty. The Vitamin C and niacinamide in the formula work wonders, visibly brightening my skin tone and giving me that much-coveted awake and refreshed look. What I love most is the creamy consistency that lays beautifully on the skin, coupled with the hyaluronic acid that hydrates and plumps up fine lines. The added caffeine reduces puffiness, making my eyes look more energized than ever. It's like a cup of coffee for my skin!

The sponge applicator is a thoughtful touch, making application a breeze and ensuring I can take this little tube of magic everywhere I go. Whether I'm heading to work or out for a night on the town, I know I can count on Clinique's Peach Color Corrector to keep me looking my best.

headline: Great product at an unbeatable price
comments:
I had only used the elf color corrector primer in the past and wanted a more targeted approach for different parts of my face.
This has been great!
I have olive skin with yellow undertones and tend to look very pale and yellowish and sickly in the winter even with makeup on.
I wear orange in the undereye area, a bit of purple in the cheeks and forehead, and green to cover the redness of period pimples. It makes a big difference and helps me look more radiant.
The order of application does matter! What has worked for me is: primer - color corrector blended with beauty sponge - foundation or bb cream - concealer and extra color corrector in pimples blended with concealer.
I will continue to buy and usea this product.

The key is not to use too much and let this stuff set. I hope this product sticks around because it has really helped me to improve my makeup routine. As a woman in my fifties, I have lines around my eyes and this does NOT accentuate them at all. It helps the area stay moist so makeup doesn't crease in there. This is truly a wonderful primer and color corrector. I highly recommend!!

headline: Not for fair skin
comments: Have been looking to replace Bobbi Brown creamy corrector pot in extra light peach.  This offered only two shade options, but peach was described as appropriate for very fair skin, so I hoped it would be ok.  It was very peach and way to dark for fair skin tones. The BB product was more like a concealer shade-a light yellow beige with a touch of peach.  It worked as corrector and concealer for me.  This product was creamy and moist with decent coverage, but just way to dark peach for what I was looking for.  Maybe I just need to find a regular concealer with peach undertones to replace the product I am trying to match, because all correctors I have tried are way too peach or pink to replace my previous perfect product.  But if you have a darker skin tone which requires a deeper peach or orange tone to counteract dark circles or discolorations, this is certainly worth trying for its creamy texture and usual Clinique appropriateness for extremely sensitive skin.

comments: Love the product. Hate the container & applicator. Product gets all over the tube. Very messy. Applicator wipes it off. Works fabulous using finger to apply.

headline: Life saver!
comments: I almost didn't purchase this because I was afraid I would look yellow but so glad I did! I use my regular foundation and put this on top and it leaves me with a nice even complexion. I've also been using the redness solutions cream in the morning which has reduced the amount of red/hot episodes but when I do have them I just add a bit more of this powder over it and it instantly evens out my skin tone. I do wish it came with a sponge or applicator in the compact but it's still worth it. Love love love it!!

headline: A Touch of Radiance with Clinique's Peach Color Corrector
comments:
Clinique's Even Better All-Over Primer and Color Corrector in Peach is a game-changer for anyone struggling with dark circles or spots. This lightweight color corrector is a true ally in my beauty arsenal, offering 12-hour wear that seamlessly integrates into my daily routine. 

The peach hue is perfect for my fair complexion, providing just the right amount of coverage without being overwhelming. It's not just a cover-up; it's a corrective experience that enhances my skin's natural beauty. The Vitamin C and niacinamide in the formula work wonders, visibly brightening my skin tone and giving me that much-coveted awake and refreshed look. What I love most is the creamy consistency that lays beautifully on the skin, coupled with the hyaluronic acid that hydrates and plumps up fine lines. The added caffeine reduces puffiness, making my eyes look more energized than ever. It's like a cup of coffee for my skin!

The sponge applicator is a thoughtful touch, making application a breeze and ensuring I can take this little tube of magic everywhere I go. Whether I'm heading to work or out for a night on the town, I know I can count on Clinique's Peach Color Corrector to keep me looking my best.

headline: Not quite a highlighter, not quite concealer - gives GLOW
comments:
I really like this product and based on reviews I feel like some people are confused about what this is, which I guess is understandable because it's kind of hard to describe. It is not a straightup highlighter, nor is it a plain old concealer. 
I wear minimal/natural makeup, not full glam, and I wouldn't really call this strictly a highlighter. I apply it on my Cupid's bow, brow bone, a bit on my forehead, whatever high points I feel like, but I also apply it under my eyes, maybe on top of some color corrector where you'd apply concealer, and it definitely isn't too much glow, it is subtle, it does seem to have some concealing/skinlike pigment and it brightens without shimmer, glitter or looking like a highlighter. It's kind of hard to describe but I'm quite fond of it and I would definitely like to continue buying it or go for the larger size. This mini is VERY mini and a lil bit smaller than I expected even knowing it would be mini, but that's ok because of the bogo sale and it is cute and there is still definitely a useable amount of product to form an opinion with.

headline: Neopolitan cream review
comments: I had high hopes for this being the perfect all in one cream face palette. The formula is thick and very pigmented. It didn't blend well with fingers or a wet sponge. It was workable using a buffing brush and dried down quickly and completely. I have a fair cool skin tone and the matte and shimmery blushes both lean a bit orangey on me. The bronzer shade is pretty deep for fair skin but it has a rosy tone so I can make it work if I only apply a tiny bit. The highlighter is nice and subtle, not too bright. I used the bronzer and highlighter it as eyeshadow and that worked out ok. I tried some on my lips but it felt thick and dry and none of the colors really work well for that in my opinion. Overall I have mixed feelings about this product but am willing to play with a bit more. In general, I wish the formula was thinner and more sheer like their water blush and bronzer.

headline: 2nd review - found a use for this primer stick
comments: I wrote the other review for L.A Girl Let's Chill Hydrating Primer Stick, and am updating it. While the intended use is as a primer, which it's too crumbly for, I think it's worth trying overtop finished makeup. I had some dehydrated, dry patches that my makeup looked cakey over (healing acne etc) and for whatever reason I grabbed this primer and applied it ON TOP. Not only did it not remove any makeup and felt super refreshing 😌, but it took care of the dry patchy cakey look! I have since been swiping this over my finished makeup either to hydrate and smooth those dry patches and get a hydrated look which fixes my makeup, or over my cheeks for added hydration and shine. I'm enjoying it now and it doesn't crumble or break as much when applied over makeup. Not a good primer but pretty good to hydrate and set trouble areas after my makeup is finished and dry.  Thought I'd mention it so if you bought this and hated it you can try it this way. I run it over the backs of my hands and cuticles too and it feels great in this hot weather.

headline: Want to like but not great...
comments:
First I love the stick application, love the light pink jelly look of the product before use, easy to hold, portable, and does have a slight cooling effect (that wears off in seconds) and feels refreshing. On the downside it breaks off into small chunks of jelly that I can't just blend or smooth over my skin and I have to just wipe it off. The first time I used it it was smooth but didn't feel THAT hydrating or seem to help my makeup application or longevity, and the second and third times it was crumbling right off the stick. Use very gently and don't skip a hydrating serum or spray:/ 
I'll keep trying it but so far I haven't found a way to love it in my routine. Might just roll over the tops my hands. 

More cooling: Try Ulta's cool and glow primer which is an underrated icy white really blendable glowy primer that really feels cool for a long time. It's excellent for pale and light cool toned skin in summer! And Wet n Wild cooling stick (forget the exact name) which is another stick balm that's lovely under my sensitive eyes and truly cooling.

headline: Peach Bums, Floral Majority, Dusty Rose Blush Sticks 💕
comments: I absolutely LOVE to experiment with different makeup looks & products! When it comes to blushes, I love to experiment with different colors & textures! I saw these Wet n Wild Blush Sticks & fell in love with the colors! I love any types of blushes, be it powder, liquid or stick & I've been using the stick blushes more than anything now! These are inexpensive but Wet n Wild still has some amazing products & these blush sticks are great! They're sheer but you CAN build them up in intensity! For my looks, I mainly use concealer & hardly any foundation, so I don't know how well they perform with foundation on, but for my look, these ALWAYS look great! Some have a sparkle but it's not chunky & it serves to illuminate the cheeks while giving a flush of color! I think ONLY Peach Bum has sparkles but again nothing that's too much! In fact it can be used as a highlighter too! Dusty Rose & Floral Majority are absolutely gorgeous too! These don't have any sparkle but they do have the pigmentation I'm looking for! I just got them, so I'm still using them in different ways & I will include swatches soon! I would definitely recommend these!

headline: Stunning with Right Technique
comments: Muted pink is the perfect matte rosey color for fair/light skin tones! Very natural and elegant. This way I can both control the high pigmentation and warm up the product for easy blending. I recommend using the brush then going back in with a beauty blender. Setting spray will help hold it in place for hours.

headline: 2nd review - found a use for this primer stick
comments: I wrote the other review for L.A Girl Let's Chill Hydrating Primer Stick, and am updating it. While the intended use is as a primer, which it's too crumbly for, I think it's worth trying overtop finished makeup. I had some dehydrated, dry patches that my makeup looked cakey over (healing acne etc) and for whatever reason I grabbed this primer and applied it ON TOP. Not only did it not remove any makeup and felt super refreshing 😌, but it took care of the dry patchy cakey look! I have since been swiping this over my finished makeup either to hydrate and smooth those dry patches and get a hydrated look which fixes my makeup, or over my cheeks for added hydration and shine. I'm enjoying it now and it doesn't crumble or break as much when applied over makeup. Not a good primer but pretty good to hydrate and set trouble areas after my makeup is finished and dry.  Thought I'd mention it so if you bought this and hated it you can try it this way. I run it over the backs of my hands and cuticles too and it feels great in this hot weather.

Use very gently and don't skip a hydrating serum or spray:/

comments: This is an excellent long-time product from Clinique.  I wear this daily as my makeup and have been for years. I love the slight yellow tint that it provides as I have a warm skin tone and this product makes me glow.  I am ivory skinned with red hair and the slight yellow tint blends out completely with no white cast and gives my skin a nice matte look. It is not runny and watery and I love how I can wear this as my foundation with concealer, blush and mascara and I am done!  It does not cause me to break out like so many no chemical sunscreen products do.  Please please do not discontinue this excellent product, Clinique, or you will lose a long time customer!  Many of Clinique's best products have been discontinued recently and replaced with far inferior products.  In order to retain your long time customers, please keep those products that we all know and love and that work effectively for sensitive acne prone skin, thank you!

headline: Not for daytime for me
comments: I've purchased this sunscreen on and off since the 90s. It's effective, but I removed one star for providing only 25 SPF. It's also *really* orange on my very fair, cool-toned skin, especially if I use the recommended amount of 1/2 to 1 tsp (major overkill if I'm not spending the day on the beach, an amount likely established by the sunscreen industry to get us to use it faster). There is absolutely no way for me to avoid the white ring around my hairline and lips, no matter how well I blend. BUT rust is the color of iron, and the iron oxides in this sunscreen can help protect against blue light emitting from LED screens. I wear this at night,  over tretinoin, as iron oxides can also help slow the breakdown of topical vitamin A. I can't avoid LEDs at night, given my work schedule, but no one can see my Oompa Loompa glow in the dark. (Note: Calling this "chemical free" is pure marketing. Both Titanium and Zinc are on the periodic table.)

headline: Radiant Rose Blush (Not Recommended for Acne Prone Skin)
comments:

It gave my cheeks a beautiful, natural flush that lasted throughout the day without fading. The pigment was rich, and it blended seamlessly into my skin, providing a radiant, healthy glow.

However, despite the gorgeous color payoff, I encountered a significant downside. Unfortunately, after a few uses, I noticed that the blush caused me to break out. As someone with sensitive skin, this was a major drawback. I had to stop using it to let my skin recover.

In summary, while the Radiant Rose Blush delivers stunning color and great wear, I would caution those with sensitive or acne-prone skin to be aware of potential breakouts. If your skin can handle it, it's a beautiful addition to any makeup routine.

headline: Radiant Rose Blush (Not Recommended for Acne Prone Skin)
comments:
I recently tried the blush and had mixed feelings about it. On the positive side, the color was absolutely fantastic. It gave my cheeks a beautiful, natural flush that lasted throughout the day without fading. The pigment was rich, and it blended seamlessly into my skin, providing a radiant, healthy glow.

However, despite the gorgeous color payoff, I encountered a significant downside. Unfortunately, after a few uses, I noticed that the blush caused me to break out. As someone with sensitive skin, this was a major drawback. I had to stop using it to let my skin recover.

In summary, while the Radiant Rose Blush delivers stunning color and great wear, I would caution those with sensitive or acne-prone skin to be aware of potential breakouts. If your skin can handle it, it's a beautiful addition to any makeup routine.
