I like how the compact is refillable, a plus and it's substantial. However I do agree with another reviewer that there needs to be a notch for ease of opening the compact. This seems like a no brained to me.

headline: Rebellious rose is gorgeous!
comments: I love this blush. It's soft and blends beautifully! I wish they would put more product in the tin instead of a useless brush. I like that the tins are refillable!

headline: Nice color selection
comments: I tried a new color this time, Mauve Mystique, and am quite happy with it. Not crazy about the short-handled brush, but I'm delighted this blush now comes in a refillable case. This blush powder gives me a light or heavier blush, depending on application. I like that it's possible to build a little more color for evening wear or keep it subtle during the daytime.

headline: Like the blush, not the pink shade
comments: The blush is great and stays put for a long time! Not the biggest fan of the pink shades but enjoy the rose tones.

headline: It's great to be home with Estee Lauder
comments: My first makeup experience with a big name was Estee Lauder, and I used a few of the serums and creams back in the day. I saw it's the most used in the USA, so I thought I'd give it a go again.  Okay, let me first say that I have ventured into the high high end realm the coco-you-know-who brand, and a lot of other blushes, but when I finally got this home, and tried it, can I say....OH MY GOSH, no patchy missed spots.  Every other blush would just not cover this one spot on my cheek. No high end or makeup guru product would work.  This blend is so light and easy to sweep onto the cheeks, and not cake or flakey.  I am so glad I came back to Estee Lauder!  I will have to try the Magnolia perfume next.  Ladies, come back home to the best line out there.  Thank you for this formulation in blush!  I got Rebellious Rose and I am very light with dark hair, and it looks fabulous! I can't wait to try the foundation next.

headline: Beautiful Blush...
comments: I bought this in Rebellious Rose. It's a nice, natural "flushed" color that stays all day. On a busy morning I'll even grab an eyeshadow brush and apply to my lids. I've always been a bronzer girl, but this shadow has been a beautiful addition to my makeup bag!

headline: Gorgeous color and finish
comments: Hydrating pigmented good performance great size i specially love the bronzer

headline: Blendable
comments: As i have gotten older my skin needs creams instead of powder. I sae these for such a good price and i got them. I love them they blend so nice and creamy. Its a perfect size too so they dont dry out and i can use them fully.

headline: Blend so smooth!
comments: You can easily build up the products depending on what kind of look you're going for, and they blend so smoothly onto skin with fingertips or a sponge! I use this after prepping skin with DIME tinted sunscreen. The highlight blends best with fingertips as it is a little dark, so warm fingers disperse the glow a little better! This is a wonderful set for someone getting into more natural & simple glowwy makeup :)

headline: Perfect!
comments: I ordered this little kit for my daughter actually. She is a toddler in her first year of dance and it is recommended they have sole makeup for recital. I was looking for something natural and light that I would feel comfortable putting on her little face and that I could apply with minimal mess if she can't sit still. When this arrived we tried it out immediately and it is absolutely perfect! The texture is nice, the color is lovely, and it stayed on while she was playing and being wild. I have no doubts it will stay put and look lovely for her recitals. She did fight me a little bit in the test run but she was more receptive of this than the hair brush so I'd say it's not too bad if you have a toddler ballerina too. I was so pleased with the packaging and quality and just everything that I'm looking at the Nudestix items I might want for my makeup bag since I rarely do my makeup anymore since having my kiddo. I would definitely recommend.

headline: As Natural As It Comes!
comments: This product I bought on a whim due to having a baby and not having the time to do a full face of makeup and feel good when I leave the house. I'm able to glide it on so fast and it blends so easily. I'm so in love with this product and how beautiful I feel when I pass by a mirror and check myself out! Lol you will not regret this if you like a more natural look and are short on time!

headline: My every day blush
comments: I love this color. It is my go-to blush for every day. My routine takes about 45 seconds. I use some cream concealer under my eyes and then rub some pretty peachy on my cheeks and voila - I'm off for my day with a simple, natural look.

headline: Purse Ready
comments: Blush is not an integral part of my routine so being able to keep this in my bag to brighten up my cheeks when I need to is great. Obviously purchased it because I can apply it, keep my hands clean and not have to carry around in additional brush or beauty blender.

headline: Amazed results! I would buy this again and again
comments: I will really say that it is a versatile and convenient product that adds a natural flush to the cheeks while also doubling as a lip color and eyeshadow. Its creamy texture blends effortlessly onto my skin, creating a seamless, dewy finish. Plus, its compact design makes it perfect for on-the-go touch-ups. Its like  a must-have for everyone who is  looking for a multi-purpose cream blush just like me that delivers beautiful results.

headline: Nudestix Blush
comments:
I love this brand. It makes makeup easy and precise. This stick is convenient and there's a brush on the other end to help blend the blush after. I do wish though that the brush part extended a bit out, it doesn't expand out and makes the application more concentrated to one spot. 
The texture of the blush stick is good, it glides on smoothly and has a nice colour, very natural and not glittery or shimmery. If you're in search of a natural finish blush, this is spot on!

headline: Amazing product
comments: Beautiful cream blush. It was my first time using a cream blush and I don't think I'll ever go back to powder. I absolutely love the consistency and the way it blends.

headline: My Blush Crush!
comments: LOVE THIS PRODUCT!! The NUDE BUFF colour is perfect for my fair skin. It goes on smooth, looks natural, and it's matte finish gives a soft blurring affect. It blends effortlessly with the convenient mini blender brush hidden on the opposite end of the blush stick (which twists off to wash, btw)! Such a great design! This blush stick has multiple purposes, so it's a great secret weapon to keep in your purse. You can also use it on your eye lids and lips. I'm not one to wear pink tones in my eye shadow, and my lips felt really dry due to this particular variation being matte. All in all, I'm super happy with this product even though I don't use it to it's fullest! My fave blush!!

headline: Definitely would recommend this product- Easy to use!
comments: This product is so easy to apply as a blush, eye shadow and lippie. Love the fact that the brush can be removed for cleaning so as not to possibly get water on the product itself. Would definitely recommend this product for how easy it is to use and how it can be used for more bolder or more neutral makeup looks. Can even be used as an enhancement when not wearing foundation at all.

headline: Goes on so effortlessly

headline: Great sophisticated highlight for light medium skin!
comments:
This is such a nice, subtle inner corner highlight for something more natural and cute! Its not for the glam girls reallg but more for a brightening effect- ive seen when i put it in the inner corners that the pinky-ness appears as you pack it on, which makes my eyes seem more awake! Though, for darker tones i would def try inner corners! Or try a light veil on the cheeks for a slight dew, though- packing it on too much on the cheeks (will appear a bit chalky considering the base of the highlight is a white pale base with the pinky highlight mixed in) 
Overall, great highlight for pale to light medium skin tones, just be careful on packing too much on thr cheeks if you are light medium and darker!

headline: Love it, under makeup!!!
comments:
This Pur Cosmetics 4-in-1 correcting primer energize & rescue is an interesting product.  It's an interesting product because a primer is mainly used under makeup.  I have never heard of using a primer without makeup like this porduct states, it can be used with or without makeup.  I like using this primer under makeup more instead of without makeup.  I just love the way it makes my makeup look.  No redness coming through with my light to medium coverage foundation, plus it looks smooth.  It even looks like my skin has a slight glow to it, which I like.  Not really sure if the slight glow is from the primer or another product I applied. None of the other products I used say its going to give a glow.    I would also say this isnt your basic primer, this one has some great ingredients like ceretin complex, shea butter, probiotics, squalane & coconut water, caffeine, and aloe.    All of these great ingredients really do help imporve the skin like reduce redness, improve dull skin, minimize the appearance of pores, helps hydrate and smooth the apprearance of uneven skin tone, and reduce the appearance of dark circles and fine lines.  

It is a light-weight formula and it has worked great with my other skincare products as well as the makeup I have been using with it.  I do let each layer dry, so I haven't experienced any balling up.  I like using this primer better with makeup, so I don't use it wihout makeup anymore. I don't like the way it feels on my skin when using alone, also doesn't take all my redness away, and I don't see reduced wrinkles!  I would rather use with makeup only, because I love the way it makes everything look.  My redness doesn't come through, and my skin looks healthy.  My skin type is dry, so I was surprised at how much I like it.  I love the packaging it's holographic and it's easy to dispense.  

Even thought this doesn't completely work for me without makeup, it does an amazing job with makeup so that makes up for it to me.

headline: Worth every penny!
comments:
I have tried so many concealers over the years, desperately seeking something that covers my dark under eye circles (genetic). Most concealers were either too light in coverage or not a good shade match. This is now my holy grail product, the unicorn I've been searching for. It offers great coverage and I find the 20.0 Medium to be a true neutral. I'd say it skews more toward light-medium since I'm not a true medium and it's perfect for me. 

For reference, the best concealer color match I've found is Smashbox's light neutral olive (it just wasn't full enough coverage for this girl's dark circles) and for foundation I wear Mineral Fusion's olive 2 in pressed powder. Basically my skin matches an olive that grew in the shade so color matches are tough.

A word about texture: if you're used to liquid concealers, this one is going to surprise you with how thick it is. You might think it's dried out. It's not! If you're used to solid/stick concealers, you'll understand it. You can only do minimal blending, so finding a good shade match will help. I use my finger to apply it using gentle taps. And if the finish is a bit too shiny for you, I find a dusting of setting powder helps give it a slightly more matte look. Also, everyone is right that a little goes a long way. I suspect one regular tube will last me more than a year, so the price is absolutely worth it.

headline: Awful Product, Don't Waste Your Money
comments: If I could give zero stars I would. This is not foundation whatsoever. At best, it's a tinted moisturizer that provides no coverage and wears off in no time. I had been wearing this product in calming alabaster for over ten years. However, the entire line seems to have changed to a tinted moisturizer and all in VERY dark shades. Clinique, what is going on?! This line is for people with rosacea. 99.9% of people with rosacea are Caucasian and VERY fair. Who are you making this product for? Certainly not the group of people it was originally intended to help. The colors are beyond too dark and it is no longer a "foundation." Please bring back the original product line for the people that desperately need it. In addition, I've never seen an orange human being in my life. So, please discard the entire line of this product. I can't imagine it could work for anyone of any skin color.

headline: Not what I expected
comments: I had extremely high hopes for this product. I read all the reviews watched the YouTube videos and was ready to go.  First I tried the shade Punta Cana (5) and it was too dark. Then I went back and got the shady Giza (6) and it was too late, so I decided to mix both of them together, hoping it would balance out. I don't understand how a product can have so much pigment but no coverage if that makes sense.  The product is highly pigmented and when you put it on, you can clearly see there's makeup on your face however, I have a few blemishesthat it provided coverage 0 coverage for.  It didn't matter how much product I went back and dabbed on the blemishes still no coverage. I even let it sit and dry down hoping that would thicken it up but still no coverage.  Also, it was not glowing or dewy for me. I looked straight up Greasy, even with just the first layer, I looked sweaty like I had been out in the sun. It was not a flattering look. I even tried powdering it down, but it just looked greasy with powder on top which basically turned cakey and even with all that I could still see my blemishes through.  I purchased this this evening and I will be returning it immediately when the store opens tomorrow.  I love Juvia's Places' products and I will still continue to support and purchase, but this just didn't work for me.  Buyer beware.

headline: Please keep making this!
comments:
Ordered: Porcelain-Beige
I am fair-skinned with neutral undertones, some golden and some rosey or pink.
My skin coverage concerns involve some dark spots from sun exposure, small lines, redness, purplish veins and dryness. I have combination skin; most oily around the t-zone and then dry everywhere else. 
I am in my early 40's but struggle most with my undereye area. Due to an eye disease, the skin around my eyes is very thin. I have tried every technique you can think of with undereye concealer and makeup tricks to help cover my circles/undereye redness/purple veins around my eyes/bags. Everything I try just seems to make me look older.
I find that regular foundations are too thick and make my skin look more dry (even with a good skin care routine beforehand including moisturizer and primer; allowing each layer to set before going to the next). I've even researched the do's and don'ts of makeup layering, e.g. not combining water-based products with silicon-based.
I switched to concealers only and color correcting to cut down on the amount of product. Most concealers are still too thick or make my lines more prominent.
NOW THIS; the IT Bye Bye Redness is working wonders for me. I am between a 10.5 to 14 in IT shades and in Tarte I use 16N for highlight and 20B for a closer skin match. I ordered the lightest shade of this product. I agree with other reviewers that it may be too dark for very fair-skinned people as this product has a peach quality to help cancel redness. 
The product does not look heavy or make me look like I have on a load of makeup. A little goes a long way. Feels very soft on the skin and doesn't rub off like other products.

headline: Holy grail of tinted serums
comments:
This stuff is the definition of "your skin but better." I've tried SO many tinted serums, wasted so much money on $40+ brands for them to be useless. I've found the easiest way to apply this is directly to your face, then blend with fingers, then blend out with a beauty blender. 

I have sensitive skin and rosacea, this is the first product I've ever used that didn't irritate or break out my skin. And weirdly, despite having pretty light coverage, this does an amazing job at covering my redness. Covering actually might not be the right word, it's more like toning almost. It doesn't look like I have anything on, yet still seems to almost eliminate my redness (which has always been severe). I have no clue how this works, I swear it's magic because  I cannot understand it. 

Coverage is somewhat buildable, but definitely meant to be used lightly. It'll get cakey if you set it with powder, and then if it gets wet it'll lift really weird, but I don't ever feel the need to use powder. Powder blush and brozer work fine over it, just not setting your whole face. I'll go all day just with this and not get oily at all, it doesn't slide off like other tinted serums, and when it does wear it looks really natural. A bit sticky at first but it will dry down, and feels like there's nothing on your face! Definitely is somewhat waterproof, by far the most oit of any other product like this I've tried. 

I've worn this to bed many times without any breakouts, and in the morning I truly can't tell whether there's any of it left on my face (in a good way), because my skin looks better after wearing this. Probably the bakuchiol, which is what prompted me to buy it bc I already use a serum with that every night that I love. 

And again, I don't have great skin to begin with, and I've gotten endless compliments on my skin since I started using this. People saying my rosacea looks better, pores, texture, etc. 

I don't bother with reviews much, but man, every time I use this stuff, every time I look in the mirror I can't stop thinking how good my skin looks, and how natural.

headline: Best foundation EVER! Oily mature skin review.
comments:
Holy Cow!  It only took me 20 years to find this product!  But seriously, this foundation looks amazing!  I have very oily skin  (now with dry patches - thanks peri menopause), large pores and I'm 50yo.  My skin is in pretty good condition due to a lifetime of avoiding the sun.  But regardless foundation on me just looks frightful and frankly always has. In my youth I opted to use pressed powder foundations but as I approached my mid 40's, that started to look like trash on my skin too. I always use a primer for oily skin, currently that's MAC Studio Fix Mattifine 12hr Shine Control, and this foundation lays down beautifully over it!  Now, I will likely have to blot my face until the end of time and I'm used to (and resigned to) that fact.  But my foundation doesn't lift or separate or settle in fine line throughout the day.  It wears very gracefully, even with occasional blotting. No patchiness either!  It is sooo close to skin-like - I'm thrilled!   

Some things to note:   This does have fragrance. I'm pretty sensitive but I find the frag to be subtle and it immediately dissipates.  Also, this does contain denatured alcohol which is a solvent and a known skin irritant.  Normally I avoid skin products with these ingredients....but I'm taking this on the chin (haha!) for now.
Application: I use 1 pump and apply with a damp Real Techniques sponge and that gives me the light coverage I prefer.  I powder with either Uoma translucent or Urban Decay Velvetizer (yes I horded some before it was discontinued).  This cancels my redness very well and reasonably controls my (excessive and unavoidable) shine.

I would go in a store and get matched to a foundation. What I thought I would be online was not what I ended up purchasing...I was slightly on the warmer and darker shade.

headline: My holy grail foundation powder for over a decade
comments: I have been a Clinique customer for over 30 years because I have extremely sensitive/fair skin and I have been using this powder foundation for at least 15 years.  I don't really want to use a bunch of products - just quick and easy while  blurring pores and imperfections weightlessly and flawlessly.  This product achieves all my goals and has aged well with me.  It's feels like I'm not wearing makeup at all.  I have tried other powder foundations and nothing else nourishes and soothes my skin while giving me a flawless "no makeup" buildable coverage glow like Almost Powder.  It also doesn't oxidize which is hard to find in super fair tones.  There have been a few times over the years when this has been really difficult to get and I've tried other products during that time and nothing else even comes close.  I am so glad for this product and recommend to everyone.  There are lots of "trendy" products out there but I think longevity and quality are what sets Clinique head and shoulders above the rest and why I hope they will be around for a long long time.  For me I prep my skin with the "Moisture Surge 100h" moisturizer that serves as an amazing "primer" to achieve a dewy, ethereal glow all day.  For "good skin" days I use a powder brush to apply and go but for days when I need more coverage I use the supplied makeup sponge.

headline: Best foundation EVER! Oily mature skin review.
comments:
Holy Cow!  It only took me 20 years to find this product!  But seriously, this foundation looks amazing!  I have very oily skin  (now with dry patches - thanks peri menopause), large pores and I'm 50yo.  My skin is in pretty good condition due to a lifetime of avoiding the sun.  But regardless foundation on me just looks frightful and frankly always has. In my youth I opted to use pressed powder foundations but as I approached my mid 40's, that started to look like trash on my skin too. I always use a primer for oily skin, currently that's MAC Studio Fix Mattifine 12hr Shine Control, and this foundation lays down beautifully over it!  Now, I will likely have to blot my face until the end of time and I'm used to (and resigned to) that fact.  But my foundation doesn't lift or separate or settle in fine line throughout the day.  It wears very gracefully, even with occasional blotting. No patchiness either!  It is sooo close to skin-like - I'm thrilled!   

Some things to note:   This does have fragrance. I'm pretty sensitive but I find the frag to be subtle and it immediately dissipates.  Also, this does contain denatured alcohol which is a solvent and a known skin irritant.  Normally I avoid skin products with these ingredients....but I'm taking this on the chin (haha!) for now.
Application: I use 1 pump and apply with a damp Real Techniques sponge and that gives me the light coverage I prefer.  I powder with either Uoma translucent or Urban Decay Velvetizer (yes I horded some before it was discontinued).  This cancels my redness very well and reasonably controls my (excessive and unavoidable) shine.

headline: The most UNDERRATED foundation!
comments: I consider myself a foundation connoisseur. As I will always spend money on all and any and every foundation product. From highend to drugstore. Complexion is whats most important to me. I have purchased over 50 foundations and contiunally come back to BareMinerals! It is perfect for combo, oily, & dry (the original) skin types. You MUST know application. PLEASE, please take the time to learn the technique in applying. If this foundation looks powdery, you are doing it wrong. When applied with a dense, fluffy brush, in circular motions and with little product at a time. It melts into the skin. Looking like a second skin and flawless. You can keep it natural or build it up to a more full coverage look. By slowly building it up, it allows the minerals to melt. Nothing powdery looking at all. I also have freckles and it allows my freckles to show through instead of appearing greyish and "covered" which is what most liquids do. If you live in a hot climate, like I do (Arizona) even if you are dry skinned, I suggest getting the matte version. Throughout the day, your natural sweat and oils will help give it more of a natural finish! I have switched several people in my family to BareMinerals and once they learn it, they are OBSESSED as well. I hope this review helps someone looking! Thank you for carrying such a wonderful prodcut, Ulta!

headline: Holy grail foundation for oily skin!

I've gotten way less breakouts since switching my foundation to this one, and my skin genuinely looks and feels better. I love it!!!

It took me a few tries to get the application right. I don't use BM brush it says to use, just a normal (cheap) foundation brush and it is fine. I've also found that I don't need to "swirl" the product on the brush before putting it on - buffing it straight onto my face works better. A "dirty" brush is better for me too! The product transfers to the skin better after using the brush with it a few times.

headline: My favorite cleansing balm!
comments:
I usually have to hunt for a polyethylene & cruelty-free cleansing balm, so when I saw Good Molecules released one, I hit the "add to cart" button immediately! They have become one of my favorite brands lately, anyway on to the review!
The packaging doesn't take up much room, is easy to use, and recyclable. I could easily find myself reusing the little tin after it is emptied. 
The product has zero scent. Like, none whatsoever. If you are sensitive to fragrance, this is the balm for you. 
The texture is really nice. Not too hard to scoop, but not too soft, and it melts with body heat easily. 
I have yet to find a makeup product this doesn't remove. Sunscreen, foundation, concealer, waterproof eyeliner, mascara, even super saturated eyeshadow & liquid lipstick. GONE! It takes a little bit of massaging of course (I find that part relaxing honestly) but I've definitely used far less effective balms before. 
I'd say a full face of makeup takes me about 20 seconds of massaging to remove, and another 10 seconds to rinse off. 
I like using the included spatula/scoop thing, and I only ever need to use a blob about an inch long for a full face of makeup. The whole tub lasts me about a month, and I use it 5 times a week.
This balm emulsifies easily into a milky looking liquid and rinses off quickly. 
If you aren't familiar with cleansing balms, you are supposed to follow them with a second cleanser, but you could possibly get away with using this alone in a pinch because it doesn't seem to leave any greasy residue behind, but I always follow it with a water based cleanser like it is intended to be used, so I'm not positive how great that would be.
Honestly the one flaw is sometimes it is tricky to close the tin completely. Usually I can't be bothered to screw the top on tightly, so I just put the plastic cover on over the product, and place the  aluminum top on loosely. Unless you are literally packing it up and taking it with you every single time you use it, I don't really see that being an issue.

TLDR: If you are looking for a low-waste, cruelty-free, fragrance-free, and very effective cleansing balm, this is the best!

The container makes it easy to grab the perfect amount and a little goes a long way.  I like to put it on before my shower and rub it in, allowing it to dissolve the make up.  Then a few quick wipes and a pump of my oily skin liquid soap and I feel so clean and ready for my clarifying lotion 4 and my DD gel!  

I am really excited that this was a new offering.  I'd love to see it available in a travel size more often, as I travel for work and the larger jar is a bit bulky for travel.

headline: Like it

headline: Surprised and satisfied

I am so happy I got to try the charcoal version because it's exactly what I've been looking for. This product doesnt make my face dry at all, and its effective AND gentle. I love it and I highly recommend!

headline: Gentle yet effective!
comments: I purchased the large origional clear pomade of this brand along with other Clinique products which got me decent size samples including the newest "charcoal" pomade. Since I have both, there's not much difference I can tell you between the two. They both work the same, eitherway the product works great and still very gentle on eyes while still removing all the built up makeup breaking it up easy while dry. The only bad thing I'd say is this that this is NOT your one stop remover and will absolutely need to follow up with their cleanser or you will breakout because it breaks down but it won't clear and wash it all off. Its fine, and I personally like this system leaving me squeaky clean.

headline: Love, love, love this product!
comments: Will definitely be buying this product again. This is the absolute best makeup remover product I have ever used.

headline: Love

headline: Wonderful make-up remover

I have been buying this product for many years - it's excellent!
ML

I love the scent, it takes me back the spa on the cruise. It doesnt feel greasy at all, in fact im pretty sure its help bring hydration to my face along with some other products. headline: Doesn't suit all skin types - too much shimmer
comments:
I re-purchased Lit Mist, as I could no longer find the Matte Mist or Miracle Mist.  I had previously bought the Lit Mist in the old packaging - it was OK, but having oily skin and large pores, the other two mists were far more suitable.  I wasn't really a fan of using Lit Mist to set my makeup, because the glowy skin finish of this one accentuates my pores and makes my face look shiny.  But as a mist underneath skincare, it's fine.  However, with this new packaging, I find that because the mist isn't as fine as the previous packaging, too many flecks of shimmer come out, and make my face look like I've accidentally been splashed with shimmery paint.  

Could PUR please bring back the Matte Mist or another mist which is more universal for all skin types.  Unfortunately this one isn't great for us large pore & oily skin people,

headline: Amazing finishing powder
comments:
For the longest time I couldn't figure out why this kept breaking up under my setting spray. The pressed powder ends up fine, but not the loose powder. 

Turns out I've been using it wrong the whole time. 

After my setting spray dries down, I swirl the loose powder over my whole face and pat in my oily T-zone with a puff. It makes me look matte and flawless and lasts the whole day without budging. The loose powder also doesn't affect the pressed powder that I used to set & brighten my undereyes. No flashback even with how much loose powder I pressed into my T-zone.

The only cons:
1) If you're dry or like glowy skin, this will be very matte & drying. It's best for combo and oily skin.
2) The loose powder is loose, so each time you unscrew it, powder flies everywhere. You can pour some into the lid, but it's hard to use this while traveling or on-the-go.
3) It is translucent, but it does make you paler after applying. If that's something you dislike, just use it for brightening the undereye.

This is a 99.9% dupe for Charlotte Tilbury flawless finishing powder.

This one MAYBE has slightly more coverage than Charlotte. Ever so slightly more. 
Finish is the same - satin matte. 
Wear is the same - surprisingly keeps my greasy pores at bay for most of the day. 
This one comes with that little rubber sponge. Charlotte doesn't. Both have mirrors. 

I don't wear foundation, only concealer, with cream blush and contour most days (work from home). This sets the cream products nicely and doesn't look cakey. This is a forever repurchase.

headline: Perfection
comments: I've always been a liquid foundation wearer. However, as I navigate through my 40s, I've noticed that pretty much any liquid I use gathers into my pores and fine lines. I was aware of powder foundations but thought, NO WAY would they give enough coverage for my problematic skin (dark circles, oily in some areas; dry in others, sun spots) so I steered clear. Recently, I decided to try powder and my friend recommended this Lorac powder. AND YA'LL - my skin is perfection with this product. The key for me is that it has something to "stick" to. I put on serum, sunscreen, spray with a dewy setting spray, then apply the powder. First with a powder pouf then a brush to blend. Then I spray with the dewy setting spray one final time. Lasts all day with no settling, smearing or greasiness! And it doesn't feel heavy or cakey. I haven't reached for liquid foundation since discovering this routine.

headline: Watch out, the shades are misleading 😐
comments: I got the shade warm honey. At first, when I looked at the pan, I thought it would have been a touch too light for my complexion but nothing I couldn't make work with a little bronzer. I was wrong. It actually applied darker. Like six shades darker. It made my base look grey and muddy, despite it being a "warm" shade that was seemingly light. I could probably use this as a contour shade so it's at least not a total waste. But I wasn't shopping for another contour shade, I wanted a pressed powder to lightly set the outer portions of my face. I'm incredibly disappointed. The shades are misleading, so be careful in your selection. If you want to make a bronzer/contour out this product, pick a shade that is almost your perfect shade match but a touch lighter. If you actually want to set your face, choose a shade several shades lighter than what you would choose. If I didn't live over an hour away from ulta, I would return the product. And I don't want to wait another five days just to exchange. It is what it is. Hope this gives a bit of insight to their shade ranges :(

It excels in creating a refined and polished look, making it a go-to product in my collection. To maximize its benefits, I recommend using a light hand during application and blending thoroughly for a seamless finish.

headline: Blurs skin
comments:
The Anastasia Translucent Loose Powder has become a staple in my makeup routine, thanks to its remarkable ability to blur imperfections and leave behind a beautifully smooth finish. Its lightweight texture effortlessly sets my makeup, ensuring a long-lasting, flawless look throughout the day.

One of the standout features of this powder is its exceptional blurring effect. It seems to magically diminish the appearance of fine lines, pores, and uneven texture, providing a soft-focus effect that enhances the overall complexion. This quality makes it an excellent choice for achieving that coveted airbrushed finish.

However, it's important to note that the shade leans towards a rather intense white tone. While this may work well for some skin tones, it can be a bit too stark for others. For those with lighter complexions, it tends to seamlessly blend in, contributing to a bright and radiant appearance. On the flip side, those with medium to darker skin tones may find it challenging to make the color work without a noticeable contrast.

Despite the potential drawback of its whiteness, the blurring capabilities of the Anastasia Translucent Loose Powder are undeniable. It excels in creating a refined and polished look, making it a go-to product in my collection. To maximize its benefits, I recommend using a light hand during application and blending thoroughly for a seamless finish.

headline: A luxe, lightweight setting powder that enhances makeup with
comments: I've been using the NARS Light Reflecting Setting Pressed Powder and it's quickly become my go-to, especially with my dry skin. headline: A luxe, lightweight setting powder that enhances makeup with
comments: I've been using the NARS Light Reflecting Setting Pressed Powder and it's quickly become my go-to, especially with my dry skin. The sleek, compact packaging is a win for me, making it feel high-end and perfect for on-the-go touch-ups. It's incredibly lightweight, and unlike other powders, it doesn't settle into fine lines or cling to dry patches, which is a blessing. As a dry skin person, I don't know how good its at oil control function but it gives my makeup a beautiful, natural finish and extends its wear without looking cakey. However, the powder puff included is a letdown. It's tricky to use and doesn't pick up the product well, so I prefer using my own brush. Despite this, I highly recommend it for anyone with dry skin looking for a setting powder that won't compromise on hydration.

headline: Extremely Disappointed with NARS Light Reflecting
comments: I recently purchased the NARS Light Reflecting Pressed Setting Powder and had high hopes for it. However, my experience has been nothing short of a disappointment.         Yesterday, as I excitedly unboxed the product, I was immediately struck by its sleek and elegant compact. It seemed like a promising addition to my makeup routine. However, my optimism quickly turned to frustration this morning when I opened it to find the entire chunk of powder had fallen out and shattered all over the floor.        This experience left me extremely upset and frustrated. The quality and durability of the product have proven to be far below my expectations. Makeup products, especially those from reputable brands like NARS, should not fall apart so easily.        In addition to the inconvenience and mess this has caused, it's also a waste of a product that wasn't cheap to begin with. I expected better from NARS, a brand known for its quality cosmetics.        I hope NARS takes this feedback seriously and works on improving the packaging and quality control for their Light Reflecting Pressed Setting Powder. As a customer, I feel let down by this experience, and it has certainly left a negative impression.        In conclusion, I cannot recommend the NARS Light Reflecting Pressed Setting Powder based on my unfortunate experience. It's crucial for brands to ensure the reliability and quality of their products, and this one falls short in that regard.

headline: Great on bare skin just as much as over makeup
comments: Remember that video that circulated a while back of the former Papa John's CEO looking incredibly greasy and disheveled, admitting he ate 40 pizzas in 30 days? Well, apparently my new medicine makes my face even greasier than that, somehow. I generally have normal/dry skin, but since I've been on this medication, I've just been so intensely oily. This finishing powder is my lifesaver -- it certain works great when used like you're supposed to, over foundation and all that good stuff. But, turns out, if you don't feel like wearing makeup one day but have skin so oily that other people can see their reflection on your forehead, try just patting some of this over your bare face and it's totally fixed. I love it, it makes my skin look the way it's supposed to again, it's super lightweight and looks like you're wearing nothing, and feels like it too. I never liked/needed any finishing powder I've tried before, especially since I feel like it makes my skin look gross and cakey and shows off all my pores, but I can't live without this one now. Never change the formula for this, KVD, because I'll be buying this as long as you've got it, and as long as it's still good. 10/10.

headline: I've bought this product over and over
comments:
I first got this product as a trial in a glam bag and I love it. I go back to it time and again. 

I'm 50+ years old and struggle to find products that work for my dry combination skin. 

I also like a natural look and primers are too heavy, too greasy, or too patchy or just don't do what they promise. Foundations of all kinds are the same level of disappointment.

This product however is a joy to use. I spritz my skin after moisturizer and it helps the products absorb.

It smooths, ever so slightly blurs and gives my skin a dewy look. I've settled on glossier skin tint and concealor and after I'm done, I spritz again to set my makeup. I also feel pretty comfortable going without makeup if I choose.

It feels so good going on and makes me look 5 years younger.

I know the price is on the high side but it lasts a very long time. I also kept my trial size and refill it from the larger one for travel. It's one of the few products that I've found is worth the price. Give the trial size a try. 

p.s. The lotion product is not as good, stick to the setting spray.

headline: Good for on the go touch ups
comments:
The Bare Minerals Original Mineral Veil Set + Protect Talc-Free Setting Powder Mineral SPF 25 is convenient for on-the-go and travel with its built-in brush. It does help to blur imperfections, absorb oil, and extend makeup wear. I also like that it has SPF 25 for added sun protection. 

Here's a breakdown of the pros and cons:

Pros:
Talc-free formula, which is ideal for those with sensitive skin
SPF 25 for sun protection
Ultra-fine powder that blends easily and gives a weightless feel
Absorbs oil to control shine and keep makeup in place
Blurs the appearance of pores and fine lines
Vegan and cruelty-free

Cons:
Loose powder can be messy to apply
May not be enough coverage for those who want to conceal blemishes
SPF 25 is not very high protection
Built-In brush is a bit small 

Overall, the Bare Minerals Original Mineral Veil Set + Protect Talc-Free Setting Powder Mineral SPF 25 is a good option for those looking for a lightweight setting powder that will control shine and blur imperfections. However, it is not a good choice for those who want high sun protection or need a lot of coverage. I would use this for travel and on-the-go touch-ups, as it's a perfect size for in my purse or carryon.

comments: I use several BareMinerals products including the mineral veil and this is a total miss. The despenser concentrates the powder in the center of the brush and there is product loss if you try and distribute it to other area of the brush. The powder does not blend well and I find it cakes in fine lines and around my nose no matter how much I attempt to blend it. It looks even more blotchy as the day goes on. headline: Good for on the go touch ups
comments:
The Bare Minerals Original Mineral Veil Set + Protect Talc-Free Setting Powder Mineral SPF 25 is convenient for on-the-go and travel with its built-in brush. It does help to blur imperfections, absorb oil, and extend makeup wear. I also like that it has SPF 25 for added sun protection. 

Here's a breakdown of the pros and cons:

Pros:
Talc-free formula, which is ideal for those with sensitive skin
SPF 25 for sun protection
Ultra-fine powder that blends easily and gives a weightless feel
Absorbs oil to control shine and keep makeup in place
Blurs the appearance of pores and fine lines
Vegan and cruelty-free

Cons:
Loose powder can be messy to apply
May not be enough coverage for those who want to conceal blemishes
SPF 25 is not very high protection
Built-In brush is a bit small 

Overall, the Bare Minerals Original Mineral Veil Set + Protect Talc-Free Setting Powder Mineral SPF 25 is a good option for those looking for a lightweight setting powder that will control shine and blur imperfections. However, it is not a good choice for those who want high sun protection or need a lot of coverage. I would use this for travel and on-the-go touch-ups, as it's a perfect size for in my purse or carryon.

headline: Dark Deep and Dark Deepest have changed

I LOVED both shades and could wear them as foundation for a very natural look.  Both worked for me depending on the season. The latest formulas are not the same. They are more like the other skinfinishes that are designed for glow.  I don't get why MAC fixes what isn't broken.  They did the same with the Spiked brow pencil and some of the lipglasses.  All in all, if you are a fan of the Mineralized Skinfinishes make sure to go in store to compare the shades before repurchasing. I am so disappointed.  I can now probably only use it to set concealer or I may have to give them away.

headline: So much goodness!
comments: I have melasma all over my face but really concentrated on my checks. Full coverage foundation and concealer alone doesnt cut it. I decided to try using the color corrector in the shade C2 for my light medium skin tone to see if that made a difference and it did! I have tried correctors in the past and had given up on them....too noticeable under my makeup... too cakey under all the other layers I am wearing, etc. But this one has renewed my interest. It is such a thin formula with coverage and the exact right shade under my foundation so I dont think it changes the color but instead blends seamlessly. I'm very impressed and happy with my purchase. Next I will try the concealer.

headline: So impressed!

headline: Does the job!
comments: I don't have major darkness under eyes but I wanted something to cover up my veins that show through because I have thin skin and then something to just touch up the inner eye area that has a teeny bit of darkness.  I have light/medium skin and got the medium peach color.  Was worried it would be drying and cakey because I've never really been able to use anything of CT's because it's irritating.  This however, works.  Texture is silky, just takes a little bit warmed between your fingers and pat it in gently.  I use a little Westman Atelier concealer over it and then also the WA pressed powder and the finish is lovely.  Lasts all day.  50 yr old with combo/dry skin.  I prep with Clarins Double Serum Eye, let it sit for a few minutes and then apply this.  Eyes stay hydrated all day.  Winner for me!

headline: This stuff is amazing!
comments: I haven't used color correctors in a while (never really had much luck years ago with them), as i just use really full coverage concealer. But as I'm aging, that much conealer accentuates my fine lines and makes my under eyes look INCREDIBLY dry after applying powder, which is necessary to prevent or minimize creasing. I watched some videos on how to help my poor undereyes, which now have dark circles as I'm aging as well. They recommended using color correctors so that you can use less concealer, and thus reduce the amount of creasing and settling into fine lines (and also use less powder). This was one of the recommended ones (I bought a few of the recommended products). I used it over the weekend on the first day, by itself. I couldn't believe how little I needed, and HOW WELL IT WORKED just on its own. My daughter looked at me and said, "you look differentâ¦.. like younger".  First win! I then wore it over the course of 4 working days under 3 different concealers (LancÃ´me Teint Idole, Dermablend Full Coverage Concealer, and Fenty We're Even Hydrating concealer). All three required SIGNIFICANTLY less concealer than I would have applied without the corrector, and they all looked beautiful. They lasted all day, with LancÃ´me lasting all day with no creasing (the other two creased just a tiny bit, not really noticeable unless you're right up to my eyes). My eyes didn't look as dry or old as with normal amounts of concealer. This stuff is phenomenal. I did buy the Elf corrector to compareâ¦.. I did not find Elf to work as well by itself, and it had more of a greasy texture that didn't make me feel like it would last the way Charlotte Tilbury would. This is DEFINITELY worth every penny. If you're on the fence, do it.

headline: Perfect for hiding dark circles
comments: The compact is tiny which makes it super convenient for touch-ups on the go. The formula is creamy and the shade fair works super well on my NC15 skin (even without concealer). I set it with a bit of powder. This lasts ages, only a little is needed.

headline: My go to under eye corrector
comments: I compare this to the smashbox (previously becca) under eye corrector. I always wanted to love the smashbox one but my skin leaned too oily to agree with the formula. The CT one however is perfect alone or under concealer. It leaves a crease free base that enahances the skin without giving the appearance of wearing makeup.

I can't let it sit for more than a second or else it will dry up and leave a patchy spot. Also it pills a lot. Do not recommend sadly, i love elf though :(

headline: Affordable and Compact Redness Solution

If you have dry skin like me, you'll need to really hydrate where you want to cover so this product can lay down without leaving streaks. Otherwise, a wonderful corrector.
